kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننقسم (form VII)
# نَنْقَسِمُ (nanqasimu) /nan.qa.si.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
# نَنْقَسِمَ (nanqasima) /nan.qa.si.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
# نَنْقَسِمْ (nanqasim) /nan.qa.sim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
